normalization.loss: float64 restored output minus float64 reference; same reference units MSE

data.public_reference: notch-conditioned recorded proxy, normalized once to reference RMS units; not physiological clean truth

training.domain_balance: equal public and long batches; cycle independently shuffled long cases

selection.objective: equal domains, equal four corrupted conditions, restored-reference-unit MSE
selection.no_eligible_epoch: save diagnostic last state with selected_epoch null and selection_gate_passed false

design: 4096 samples at native 250 Hz = 16.384 seconds; expected improvement of slow drift is a hypothesis to evaluate, not an achieved result.

v12 diagnostic window oracle MSE about 0.128 versus v12 about 0.864; retained-window-mean lower bound about 23.5% of window MSE. This is not proof of pure structural impossibility. Long context tests training-distribution and low-frequency-resolution hypotheses.
Synthetic references are continuously generated at 4096 points, never tiled 512-point snippets. No class, target, condition or gaze enters forward; no template replacement.
Fixed 50 Hz Q30 notch is measured separately from the learned residual.
DC and discrete 8-40 Hz bins are protected; white noise inside that band cannot be removed by this model. No broad-spectrum noise-removal claim.
Positive Hann overlap-add of residuals includes a final window; global protected-band/phase preservation is not mathematically guaranteed by per-window masks.
Recorded public proxies are not physiological clean truth. Long synthetic references are artificial numerical benchmarks. Public subjects 7/8 were historically accessed and are not pristine holdout.
Personal sessions and public 7/8 are excluded from fit, selection and freeze. No default deployment; independent physiological and whole-record evaluation remain required.
